Project Role : LLM Full Stack Engineer


Project Role Description : Develop and integrate applications with Large Language Models (LLMs) and other enterprise services. Leverage front-end and server-side technologies to develop APIs, implement DevOps practices, and optimize Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications.


Must have skills : Generative AI


Good to have skills : NA
Minimum
5 year(s) of experience is required


Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education


Summary:
As an LLM Full Stack Engineer, a typical day involves designing and building applications that seamlessly integrate Large Language Models with various enterprise systems. The role requires balancing front-end and back-end development tasks, creating robust application programming interfaces, and ensuring smooth deployment through DevOps methodologies. The engineer continuously works to enhance the performance and scalability of Artificial Intelligence applications, collaborating with diverse teams to deliver innovative solutions that meet organizational goals.


Roles Responsibilities:

Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.

Responsible for team decisions.

Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.

Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.

Lead the design and implementation of scalable AI-driven applications that leverage Large Language Models.

Mentor junior team members to support their professional growth and technical development.

Coordinate cross-functional efforts to align project objectives and ensure timely delivery.


Professional Technical Skills:


Must To Have Skills:

Proficiency in Generative AI.

Experience with front-end and back-end development technologies relevant to AI application integration.

Strong understanding of application programming interface design and development.

Familiarity with DevOps practices to support continuous integration and deployment.

Ability to optimize AI models and applications for performance and scalability.

Experience collaborating in multi-disciplinary teams to deliver complex software solutions.

The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Generative AI.

This position is based at our Chennai office.

A 15 years full time education is required.


Qualification 15 years full time education
